reminder: Recording laws vary. Tell everyone in the meeting you're recording and get their consent where the law requires it.
microphone: Only your microphone will be recorded. Other people on a Zoom, Teams or Meet call won't be in the recording.
system: Only sound from this computer will be recorded. Your own voice won't be in the recording.
systemPermission: SonoJot needs your permission to record system audio. If you allow it after the meeting starts, the other side is recorded from then on.
systemUnsupported: Recording system audio needs macOS 14.2 or later.
systemOnlyBlocked: Nothing from this computer can be recorded until you allow system audio.
